summary: Iteration 55: Squadron Schedule View Feature Testing. All frontend tests PASS. The new squadron view mode is fully functional with correct UI elements, headers, and event display.

issues: Console warnings about HTML hydration errors (<tr> cannot be child of <span>, etc.) - these are React development warnings from the Emergent visual editor wrapper, not actual bugs

critical_code_review_comments: SquadronScheduleView component correctly implements SQUADRONS config with 4 groups (6th CTS, 21st CTS, 22nd CTS, 16th OPS SUP)
Flight sub-columns correctly mapped: A/B under 6th CTS, C/D under 21st CTS, E/F under 22nd CTS
eventMatchesColumn function correctly handles 'all' target_groups to show events in all columns
Color coding correct: 6th CTS (blue), 21st CTS (red), 22nd CTS (emerald/green), 16th OPS SUP (amber)
Time slots correctly displayed on left side with sticky positioning
View toggle buttons (day/squadron/list) all functional with proper active state styling
context_for_next_testing_agent: Squadron Schedule View feature fully tested and working. The view shows a multi-column grid with 4 squadron columns and 7 total flight columns. Events with target_groups 'all' appear in all columns. Honor Agreement modal must be signed before accessing the app.

A, B under 6th CTS; C, D under 21st CTS; E, F under 22nd CTS; empty for 16th OPS SUP
